parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.

parameters.name: Instance
parameters.description: The information about the nodes to be deleted.

sub_parameters.name: Id
sub_parameters.description:
The ID of the compute node to delete. You can specify up to 100 nodes.

You can call the [DescribeCluster](~~87126~~) operation to query the IDs of nodes in a specified cluster.

parameters.name: ReleaseInstance
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to release the nodes that are created by E-HPC.

Default value: true

parameters.name: Sync
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to delete the nodes immediately. Valid values:

- true: Yes
- false: No
